searchText: FOCIL 41 A local focil-devnet-0 debugging thread. Following the discussion in the breakout on the non-zero requirements, I've merged the [CL spec PR #5576](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5576), and I've opened an [engine APIs PR #878](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/878) (because I don't have a permission to modify #870). Please review when you have some time.
